melodee.why: the Hub package has no factory sounds (res.c at 0xCB000); Melodee's installer writes them

krisjangle.why: the Hub package has no resource region (Santa's voice clips; fm1-base device/res.c at 0x98000); the release's kris-jangle-0.12-res.bin is what the installer writes

loom.why: the Hub package has no resource region (the 909 samples; fm1-base device/res.c at 0xab000); the release's loom-0.15.1-res.bin is what the installer writes

polly.why: the Hub package has no resource region (its samples; fm1-base device/res.c at 0xab000); the release's polly-0.6.4-res.bin is what the installer writes
